messages:
maria: Heads up — customer asked for line-level attribution in audit exports for routing policy changes. They want one NDJSON stream with actor, actor_type, reason, before/after, rollout_id (if any), and a stable action_id. Also need a console anchor so they can jump to the exact diff. Any thoughts on shape and surfacing? cc @compliance-bot

sam: +1 on NDJSON. Anchor URL makes sense. We should include change_set_id and a timestamp_ms. Keep fields flat for SIEM ingestion.

owen: How do we represent rollbacks? if we have action_type: create/update/delete + prev_value/new_value that should cover it. For big configs we can include a b64-encoded patch or a URL to stored blob.

jess: UX note: console should open the policy diff and highlight the changed field. If export includes field_path (like routing.steps[2].match.headers[0]) we can deep-link and render a small inline diff preview.

lee: Important: redact secrets. Any keys/tokens in policy blobs must be scrubbed in exports. Recommend export metadata include redact_rules and field_allowlist so customers can opt-in to verbose dumps.

compliance-bot: automated: current export pipeline produces gzipped NDJSON. Proposal v2: add action_id, change_set_id, anchor_url, triggered_by_request_id, and a policy_version. Schema PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/platform/audit-schema/pulls/42

sam: example NDJSON line (proto sketch):
```
{"ts_ms":1690000000000,"action_id":"a-123","actor":"alice@custco.com","actor_type":"user","action_type":"update","policy_id":"routing-x","policy_version":"v3","change_set_id":"cs-987","field_path":"routes[1].backend","prev_value":"us-east-1","new_value":"us-west-2","rollout_id":"r-555","rollout_state":"canary","canary_percentage":10,"anchor_url":"https://console.redwood.ai/policies/routing-x?diff=cs-987#field=routes[1].backend","triggered_by_request_id":"req-222"}
```

maria: Can we also include a linkable 'evidence' hash or list (e.g. evaluation/hash) so auditors can tie this to test/eval results? That would help compliance teams.

owen: API design opinion: prefer top-level flat fields where possible. For large diffs, add diff_blob_url and diff_blob_digest instead of inlining huge blobs. Use base64 for binary.

jess: Also add rollout metadata: rollout_state, canary_percentage, started_by, and any AB test id. Console filters should surface "policy changes during active rollouts".

lee: PII/redaction plan: default export masks email domains and secrets unless customer requests full export. Add export-level flags: include_redacted=false/true and a redaction_audit_trace entry listing redacted fields.

deploy-bot: note: rollout events already emit release_id and deploy_job_id to infra logs — can reuse release_id as rollout_id so we link infra and policy exports.

sam: next steps: ow en/lee draft schema + redaction rules; jess/sam sketch anchor URL patterns and console UX; maria will open RFC referencing compliance-bot PR. If folks agree I can prototype NDJSON writer this week.

maria: sounds good. I'll create a short RFC and assign owners. thanks all :thumbsup:
